capability: Deterministic candidate- and formula-bound CRO feasibility packet drafter, validator, and Ed25519 DSSE signer/verifier. CroProtocolPackageV2::draft constructs an unsigned packet with SHA-256 bindings to (a) the canonical candidate JSON and (b) the equivalent_balance record, populates all 8 REQUIRED_CRO_CLAIM_LOCKS to true, hardcodes execution_authorized=false / ranking_eligible=false / authority_ceiling='AUDIT_ONLY' / status='DRAFT_FOR_CRO_FEASIBILITY_REVIEW', and computes packet_id = 'cro-feasibility-' + stable_hash(unsigned_packet). CroProtocolPackageV2::validate enforces schema equality, packet_id recomputation match, candidate_sha256 recomputation match, formula_sha256 recomputation match, non-empty custody/controls/required_outputs, frozen review statuses, execution non-authorization, authority ceiling AUDIT_ONLY, ranking_eligible false, all 8 REQUIRED_CRO_CLAIM_LOCKS true, and no claim_locks value being false. sign() invokes Ed25519 DSSE over canonicalized unsigned bytes; verify_signature() checks payload_type binding + DSSE signature against a TrustStore. #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)] rejects any prose-waiver / override_note extension at deserialization time. Grants no batch-release, manufacturing-qualification, regulatory, safety, procurement, or optimizer authority under any input; solver_use_ceiling=DISABLED.
population: Five hand-authored CRO feasibility packet campaigns spanning coating-industry categories: marine primer (DGEBA/TETA, 100/25 g), industrial-maintenance topcoat (DGEBA/IPDA, 100/30 g), epoxy flooring (DGEBF/TETA, 150/40 g), structural adhesive (DGEBA/MXDA, 100/35 g), electronic encapsulant (DGEBA/DDA, 100/15 g). Each with an independent 32-byte Ed25519 signing key registered in a fresh TrustStore. Eighteen fail-closed probes distributed across the six module-specific attack axes (3 CRO_IDENTITY_HASH_SUBSTITUTION, 3 INCOMPLETE_PROTOCOL_SECTIONS, 3 FALSE_CRO_EXECUTION, 4 BANNED_CRO_PERFORMANCE_CLAIM, 3 CRO_SIGNATURE_DEFECT, 2 CRO_PROSE_WAIVER).
split_methodology: No fitting - CRO feasibility-packet packaging is closed-form deterministic hashing + Ed25519 signing over canonicalized bytes. Every campaign's expected packet_id is analytically defined as 'cro-feasibility-' + stable_hash(unsigned_packet). Every SHA-256 binding is bit-exact recomputable in the harness. Every fail-closed probe mutates exactly one packet field and asserts validate() or verify_signature() returns Err. Byte-stability across draft() replays is confirmed by comparing packet_id, candidate_sha256, formula_sha256, and claim_locks across two independent invocations with identical inputs.
theory: DSSE (Dead Simple Signing Envelope, in-toto Attestation v1.0, 2020) - payload_type-bound signature envelope. Ed25519 signature scheme (Bernstein, Duif, Lange, Schwabe & Yang, 'High-speed high-security signatures,' CHES 2011; RFC 8032, 2017) - deterministic EdDSA on curve25519 with strong forgery resistance. SHA-256 canonical-JSON binding (NIST FIPS 180-4, 'Secure Hash Standard,' 2015). Merkle 1988 'A Digital Signature Based on a Conventional Encryption Function' Advances in Cryptology CRYPTO 87 - tamper-evident hash chains. ICH Q9(R1) 'Quality Risk Management' (2023 revision) and ICH E6(R3) 'Good Clinical Practice' (2023) - protocol lock, deviation-log, and chain-of-custody requirements analogous to CRO feasibility contracts. FDA Guidance for Industry 'Contract Manufacturing Arrangements for Drugs' (2016) - traceability requirements between sponsor and contract-research organization. NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 (2020) AU-6 & CM-6 - audit-record and configuration-integrity controls. OWASP ASVS 4.0 V9 (Communication Security) and V10 (Malicious Code) - signature-based artifact integrity methodology. Kerckhoffs 1883 'La Cryptographie Militaire' - open-cryptosystem principle underlying independent trust-store verification.

metrics.name: packet_draft_ok_rate
metrics.note: Fraction of the 5 campaign packets for which CroProtocolPackageV2::draft returns Ok. Five packets, all Ok.

metrics.name: packet_id_matches_computed_rate
metrics.note: Fraction where packet.packet_id == packet.computed_packet_id() (recomputed 'cro-feasibility-' + stable_hash(unsigned_packet)). Five packets, all match.

metrics.name: candidate_and_formula_sha256_binding_correctness_rate
metrics.note: Fraction where packet.candidate_sha256 == stable_hash(candidate_binding) AND packet.formula_sha256 == stable_hash(serde_json::to_value(equivalent_balance)) bit-exact. Independent recompute in the harness. Five packets, all bit-exact.

metrics.name: all_eight_required_cro_claim_locks_true_rate
metrics.note: Fraction where every one of the 8 REQUIRED_CRO_CLAIM_LOCKS (NO_EXECUTION_AUTHORITY, NO_PROCUREMENT_AUTHORITY, NO_SAFETY_CLAIM, NO_SYNTHESIS_CLAIM, NO_PERFORMANCE_CLAIM, NO_QUALIFICATION_CLAIM, NO_RANKING_AUTHORITY, UNMADE_DIGITAL_PROPOSAL) is present and mapped to true, AND no claim_locks value is false. Five packets, all locked.

metrics.name: execution_authority_locked_false_rate
metrics.note: Fraction where execution_authorized == false, ranking_eligible == false, authority_ceiling == 'AUDIT_ONLY', schema, status ('DRAFT_FOR_CRO_FEASIBILITY_REVIEW'), safety_review_status ('UNRESOLVED_REQUIRES_EHS_REVIEW'), material_availability_status ('UNRESOLVED_REQUIRES_VERIFICATION'), chemist_review_status ('REQUIRED_NOT_COMPLETED'), and cro_acceptance_status ('REQUIRED_NOT_COMPLETED') all bit-exact. Five packets, all locked.

metrics.name: sign_verify_round_trip_rate
metrics.note: Fraction where sign(key_id, signing_key) followed by verify_signature(trust_store) returns Ok(matching key_id). Independent Ed25519 signing key per packet, single-entry TrustStore. Five packets, all round-trip.

metrics.name: cro_identity_hash_substitution_fail_closed_rate
metrics.note: CRO_IDENTITY_HASH_SUBSTITUTION attack axis. Three probes: (a) candidate_sha256 replaced with a valid 64-hex zeroed string (recomputation mismatches stored hash); (b) candidate_binding mutated (recomputed hash no longer matches stored); (c) formula_sha256 substituted. All three return Err from validate().

metrics.name: incomplete_protocol_sections_fail_closed_rate
metrics.note: INCOMPLETE_PROTOCOL_SECTIONS attack axis. Three probes: (a) custody_requirements emptied; (b) controls emptied; (c) required_outputs emptied. All three return Err from validate().

metrics.name: false_cro_execution_fail_closed_rate
metrics.note: FALSE_CRO_EXECUTION attack axis. Three probes: (a) execution_authorized flipped to true; (b) status upgraded from 'DRAFT_FOR_CRO_FEASIBILITY_REVIEW' to 'APPROVED_FOR_CRO_EXECUTION'; (c) cro_acceptance_status forged from 'REQUIRED_NOT_COMPLETED' to 'APPROVED'. All three return Err from validate().

metrics.name: banned_cro_performance_claim_fail_closed_rate
metrics.note: BANNED_CRO_PERFORMANCE_CLAIM attack axis. Four probes: (a) NO_PERFORMANCE_CLAIM lock stripped; (b) authority_ceiling upgraded from 'AUDIT_ONLY' to 'SCORED'; (c) ranking_eligible flipped to true; (d) NO_PERFORMANCE_CLAIM value forced to false. All four return Err from validate().

metrics.name: cro_signature_defect_fail_closed_rate
metrics.note: CRO_SIGNATURE_DEFECT attack axis. Three probes: (a) signed with key A, verified against TrustStore containing only key B (unknown-signer failure); (b) packet mutated after signing (payload no longer matches signed bytes); (c) verify_signature() called on unsigned packet (signature absent). All three return Err from verify_signature().

metrics.name: cro_prose_waiver_fail_closed_rate
metrics.note: CRO_PROSE_WAIVER attack axis. Two probes: (a) JSON with added 'waiver: prose exception' field; (b) JSON with added 'override_note: chemist-approved verbal override' field. Both rejected at serde deserialization time by #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)] - no prose-style override can enter the CroProtocolPackageV2 type.

metrics.name: authority_envelope_preservation_rate
metrics.note: For every serialized CroProtocolPackageV2 payload, no key matches batch_release, release_authorized, qualified, authorized_by, manufacturing_qualification, or release_authority. Five packets, all locked.

metrics.name: byte_stable_two_replay_rate
metrics.note: Observational. draft() invoked twice with identical inputs produces identical packet_id, candidate_sha256, formula_sha256, and claim_locks map.

fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.prediction_rule: For (campaign_id, candidate, equivalent_balance, sample_blinding_code): construct unsigned CroProtocolPackageV2 with schema = amphora.cro-protocol-package.v2, hardcoded status/statuses/authorities/claim_locks/custody/controls/required_outputs; candidate_sha256 = stable_hash(candidate); formula_sha256 = stable_hash(equivalent_balance); packet_id = 'cro-feasibility-' + stable_hash(unsigned_packet_with_empty_packet_id_and_no_signature); validate() enforces every binding + status invariant; sign(key_id, key) computes DSSE envelope over canonicalized unsigned bytes; verify_signature(trust_store) checks payload_type + Ed25519 signature + payload byte-equality. All invariants are compile-time-frozen constants; the runtime carries no learned parameters and no user-configurable thresholds.
fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.note: Signed-packet contract. No parameters to learn; the theory is DSSE + Ed25519 + SHA-256 hash-bound feasibility packet plus ICH Q9(R1)/E6(R3) protocol-lock methodology (frozen custody, controls, required-output sections; no prose waivers).
